payload.title: Mykonos Wedding Guide to Venues, Seasons and Paperwork
payload.audience: Couples in their 30s interested in destination weddings and luxury experiences, AUD 150k+ budget
payload.reader: An Australian couple in their 30s with a budget of AUD 150k or more, planning a celebration for guests flying in from Australia. Mykonos is on the shortlist, perhaps against Santorini or Paros, and they are now planning: which part of the island and which kind of venue suits them, which months work for an outdoor ceremony, and what paperwork an Australian couple needs and how early. They want one confident page that settles those three questions before they request venue quotes.
payload.goal: Book a Wedded Concierge consultation (speak with a Wedded Advisor) at /wonderland-concierge.
payload.angle: Mykonos is planned on three decisions, made in order: legal or symbolic, which sets the paperwork clock; the season, read from the Hellenic National Meteorological Service Mykonos station and current Smartraveller advice rather than a 'best month' claim; and the setting, chosen by area and venue type before any venue name. Page-one results lead with party-island imagery, venue lists and dated prices. This guide gives an Australian couple the practical version: official climate data for the island, the Australian Embassy Athens and Smartraveller steps dated as at November 2026, the questions that decide house rules and bookings, and a short run of real venue examples that hands off to the full Mykonos venues guide.
must_include: Direct answer in the first 100 words: a Mykonos wedding comes down to three decisions (legal or symbolic and the paperwork it starts, the season, and the area and venue type), and this guide takes them in order; link /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues prominently and the Greece hub /destinations/europe/greece.
Exactly 4 Key takeaways, each one concise sentence, no figures, no prices, no best month.

Outline spine from 00-input notes (see section_plan): intro; Key takeaways; why couples choose Mykonos (official tourism only); venues (area and venue type, 5 to 6 one-line examples, prominent venues guide link); seasons; paperwork (main section); getting there; house rules and booking questions; FAQ; close. Headings in sentence case, no pasted or bracketed keywords.

Venues section short: choosing an area and a venue type, then 5 to 6 example venues with one line each, each re-checked live on the venue's own official site (batch A), then a prominent link to /destination-weddings/mykonos-wedding-venues; no repeated venue entries, no capacity tables, no contact details.

Seasons from the Hellenic National Meteorological Service climatology labelled as the Mykonos station; the meltemi only as an official source states it; Smartraveller heat, wildfire, swimming, ferry wind and earthquake advice dated once as at November 2026; no best month stated as fact.

Paperwork as the main section, official sources only, dated as at November 2026: legal or symbolic; certificate of no impediment and notarial services at the Australian Embassy Athens; Smartraveller getting married overseas, recognition in Australia, legalisation and apostilles; Municipality of Mykonos civil marriage only if an official page is read live, else 'check with the Municipality of Mykonos and the embassy, including any fees'. No apostille, translation or same-sex marriage position stated without an official source.

Getting there: Mykonos airport and port from official sources only; transfers and step-free access written as questions to ask, no claims. House rules and booking questions (deposits, cancellation, exclusive use and for how many days, music times) as questions only.

One Wedded Advisor line in the body (after the venues section, primary CTA) plus the close; Advisor claims only from brand-facts.md (one Wedded Advisor as a single point of contact, works in your time zone and quotes in AUD, fee agreed in writing before work begins, inclusions confirmed in writing, plans venue, travel, vendors and payments). FAQ 5 to 6. Link /expert-advice/greek-wedding-traditions once and /magazine once as the magnet. A short figure-free 'what shapes the cost' paragraph linking /destination-weddings/greece-wedding-packages only if SEO shows cost intent.
avoid: Any price, fee, euro or AUD figure, 'from' price, amount or percentage anywhere, including FAQ, meta and takeaways.
Repeating the Mykonos venues guide: more than one line per venue, more than 6 venues, capacity tables or venue detail.

Research talk in copy (what we could or could not find, trace or confirm; our sources or method; 'on its own site', 'in its own words', 'does not publish' as our search; page dates as source talk; myths); per-line source credits; hedge stacking; 'often told' more than once.
'Best' ranking claims for venues, areas or months; weather or meltemi claims not from an official source.
Anything implying the Advisor handles legal, church or religious paperwork; transfer arrangements; Wedded Privileges; Advisor claims beyond brand-facts.md.
The phrases 'from first idea to the last dance' and 'last dance'.
Stating whether Greece requires an apostille or translation, or the same-sex civil marriage position, without an official source.
Competitor wedding sites, directories, planner blogs, booking sites, review sites or Wikipedia as sources; competitor wording, claims or images.
Vendor names other than the example venues; business or contact details; implied partnerships.
Party-island cliches, exclamation marks, pasted or bracketed keywords in headings, em dashes, US spelling.
AI images of any venue, destination or wedding; competitor images except as reference-only.

This post owns the broad planning intent (mykonos wedding, getting married in mykonos, best time to get married in mykonos as data not a verdict, mykonos elopement if SEO supports). SEO to check rankings for the variants and recommend the split.
payload.intro_plan: Open on the reader's decision (Mykonos is on the shortlist and they need venue, season and paperwork settled), give the direct answer in the first 100 words, then link the Mykonos venues guide and the Greece hub.
payload.key_takeaways_rule: Exactly 4 Key takeaways, each a single concise sentence, no figures or prices, no best month, one per pillar plus one on booking questions.
key_takeaways_plan: Decide early whether your ceremony will be legal or symbolic, because that choice sets the paperwork and the timeline.
Choose the area and the kind of venue first, then narrow to names using the full Mykonos venues guide.
Read the Mykonos weather by month from official climate data and plan ceremony times around summer heat and wind.
Ask every venue about deposits, cancellation, exclusive use and music times in writing before you commit.
